Annotation Interface CircuitBreaker

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({METHOD,TYPE,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) @Retryable public @interface CircuitBreaker
Variation of Retryable that implements the Circuit Breaker pattern. Has higher overhead than Retryable as a CircuitState has to be maintained for each method call
Since:
1.0
Author:
graemerocher

    • name

      String name
      The name of a circuit breaker of the CircuitBreakerRegistry whose circuit the method shares, e.g. with other methods and with the programmatic circuit breakers of the same name: they open, half-open and close together. The method keeps its own retries, those of this annotation. The reset timeout and the rolling window of the circuit are those of the configuration micronaut.retry.circuit-breakers.<name>, if any, and a method that declares others fails. Without a configuration, every user of the name must have the same ones, the defaults included, or its calls fail with an IllegalStateException that names both users. Empty, the default, for a circuit of the method alone.
      Returns:
      The name of the circuit breaker, or empty
      Since:
      5.3.0
      Default:
      ""

    • requestVolumeThreshold

      String requestVolumeThreshold
      The size of the rolling window of the calls of a closed circuit, as in MicroProfile Fault Tolerance, see CircuitBreakerWindow: the circuit opens when the window is full and the ratio of failures in it reaches failureRatio(). Setting it, or failureRatio(), successThreshold(), failOn() or skipOn(), gives the circuit a rolling window, with the defaults of the others. Empty, the default, for the circuit breaker of Micronaut: the first failure that survives the retries opens the circuit, and the first success of a half-open circuit closes it. The outcome of a call is the outcome after its retries; an exception that excludes() or predicate() does not retry counts as a success.
      Returns:
      The number of calls of the window, e.g. "20", or empty
      Since:
      5.3.0
      Default:
      ""

    • failureRatio

      String failureRatio
      Returns:
      The ratio of failures of a full window that opens the circuit, between 0 and 1, default 0.5 when the circuit has a rolling window, see requestVolumeThreshold()
      Since:
      5.3.0
      Default:
      ""

    • successThreshold

      String successThreshold
      Returns:
      The number of trial calls of a half-open circuit with a rolling window, which all succeed to close it, default 1; the other calls of the half-open circuit are rejected
      Since:
      5.3.0
      Default:
      ""
